response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value ORDER BY share_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
